title: Evaluating Convolutional and Transformer Architectures for Photovoltaic Defect Classification via Electroluminescence Imagery
mechanism: Controlled benchmark: six backbones, identical preprocessing and training, stratified 5-fold CV, 150 runs; recommends module-grouped validation.
adaptation: Copy the protocol shape for our benchmark but with module-grouped 5-fold CV over the 532 train + val cells (fold roots exist).
min_experiment: Benchmark design item: house on module-grouped 5-fold, report fold spread; decides the smallest detectable effect.
evidence: R: 20,000 proprietary cells; ConvNeXt-T best macro-F1 93.12%.

alt_notes.adaptation: Copy the 'identical pipeline, all folds, mean +/- SD' reporting, with module-grouped folds and pixel metrics.
alt_notes.min_experiment: None for scores. Cite it as evidence that the EL field sees the split problem.
